name: Sanford Health Equip Bismarck
old_description: Our Bismarck location is experiencing high call volumes and wait times.
about:
Sanford Health Equip Bismarck operates as a retail location in Bismarck, North Dakota, at 2700 State Street, Suite C. The facility is part of the Sanford Health Equip network, which provides durable medical equipment and healthcare accessories to the region. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed for this specific location.

The location stocks a broad range of durable medical equipment, including bathroom safety products, CPAP devices and supplies, home respiratory and oxygen equipment, incontinence products, wheelchair and mobility aids, women's specialty items, lift chair recliners, orthotics and prosthetics, power scooters, skin and wound care supplies, compression garments, nutritional supplies, and breast pumps. The team assists customers with product selection and fitting to match individual conditions and lifestyles. The store operates Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

The business serves patients and caregivers seeking home medical equipment for mobility, respiratory, incontinence, and post-surgical needs. Customers include individuals recovering from surgery, managing chronic conditions, or requiring assistive devices for daily living. Healthcare providers may also refer patients for equipment procurement.

Sanford Health Equip emphasizes empowering independence through high-quality products and personalized service, aiming to make everyday life easier and safer for its clients.
